description:
Bad Bad Hats have a fifth album in the works! Hear the details from Kerry Alexander 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Bad Bad Hats' frontperson Kerry Alexander shared a little bit of an exclusive during her recent interview with The Current's Jill Riley: Bad Bad Hats have a new album in the works. "We are basically done with our fifth album," Alexander says. "We're into logistics at this point." 

Part of those logistics is deciding how many songs to include on the album. Hear more about it from Alexander in the video above. Bad Bad Hats' most recent effort was their 2024 self-titled release on @dongiovannirecords.

author: The Current
description:
Watch Ber perform "Book Cover" from her album 'Good, Like It Should Be'
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

As part of Minnesota Music Month, singer-songwriter Ber — aka Berit Dybing, originally from Bemidji, Minnesota — participated in a live taping of The Local Show recorded in the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio. Ber's debut full-length album, 'Good, Like It Should Be,' released on April 3, 2026, just days before this recording session. On The Local Show, Ber performed solo versions of three songs off the new album before sitting down for a chat with The Local Show host, Diane.

"I moved [to Minneapolis] when I had literally nothing," Ber tells Diane, "and The Current started spinning my tunes, and it's fully the reason why I'm doing this today. ... I very much don't take this for granted."

Watch a performance of "Book Cover" above.
